full_judgment:
Mr. Mahmudul Amin Choudhury, J: This petition for leave to appeal is against judgment and order dated 21.7.1998 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2682 of 1995 affirming the judgment and decree passed by the Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Sylhet in Title Appeal No. r32 of 1986 allowing the appeal and reversing the judgment and decree passed by the learned Munsif, Sadar, Sylhet in Title Suit No. 294 of 1980 dismissing the suit. 

 4. Before the trial court both sides adduced oral and documentary evidence in support of their respective cases. The learned Munsif on consideration of the evidence on record dismissed the suit against which the plaintiff preferred Title Appeal No. 132 of 1986 and the appellate court decreed the suit. The contesting defendant then moved the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2682 of 1995 and a Single Bench of that Division by judgment dated 21.7.1998 discharged the Rule and affirmed the judgment and order passed by the appellate court.
